lines.t: You called across the wilderness of my heart,
And I trembled at the sound of Your voice.
You spoke, and the noise of this world fell silent,
For Your mercy became my only choice.
O Lord, I am Yours — lead me home,
Through the fire, through the wind, through the rain.
Write Your truth upon my heart within,
That I may live for the glory of Your name.
You said, “My child, do not wander in pride,
For the way of My light is narrow and true.”
I laid down my burdens and fell at Your feet,
And found that my soul had been waiting for You.
O Lord, I am Yours — lead me home,
Through the fire, through the wind, through the rain.
Write Your truth upon my heart within,
That I may live for the glory of Your name.
You are the breath, the Word, the flame,
The voice that thunders yet whispers my name.
Let every tear be a seed of grace,
Until I behold You face to face.
O Lord, I am Yours — lead me home,
Through the fire, through the wind, through the rain.
Write Your truth upon my heart within,
That I may live for the glory of Your name.
Now I walk in the shadow of Your wings,
Forever in the song the Shepherd sings.
